title: Hear our prayer

lines.text: And we need Your grace today,
Our Father, who art in Heaven,
Our Father, hear us from Heaven,
May Your glory fill the earth,
As the waters cover the seas.
That is standing in the way,
Who have crossed that river before,
And this is the song well be singing forever.
Holy is the Lord ! Holy is the Lord.
Holy is the Lord ! Holy is the Lord.

lyrics:
[Verse]
 Hear our prayer,
we are Your children,
And weve gathered here today,
Were gathered here to pray.
[Verse]
[Verse]
Hear our cry,
Lord, we need Your mercy,
And we need Your grace today,
Hear us as we pray.
[Verse]
[Verse]
[Chorus]
Our Father, who art in Heaven,
Hallowed be thy name,
Our Father, hear us from Heaven,

[Verse]
